decisions.reason: The candidate already has a message-672 MODIFY establishing one ticket and one $5 commission per primary mint across reward-accounting views, including no-referral rewards; no additional state change is required.

The FAQ already explains that every primary mint produces one commission and ticket and that no-code rewards go to a random holder; the source reports accounting accuracy rather than changing the required FAQ content.
The source concerns reward accounting for primary mints and does not alter which NFT state transfers on a secondary sale.
Ticket and commission accounting does not change badge definitions, award milestones, storage, or effects.
The mention of NFT attributes concerns reward values, not NFT image, ebook-link, or wallet asset rendering.
The About-page copy already states the primary-mint commission and ticket rules; the source identifies missing accounting in runtime views rather than requesting About-page copy changes.
Reward accounting has no effect on the responsive badge-grid arrangement.
The source does not change fiat-wallet provisioning, authentication, reward access, confirmation, or cash-out guidance.

The candidate already requires one randomly assigned $5 commission and Small Block ticket for each successful no-referral primary mint; the source reports that these rewards are not being accounted for in views rather than changing their allocation.
The source does not request a change to Mission-page messaging or its prize-pool description.

The candidate already requires one ticket per successful primary mint, including no-referral mints; the source changes accounting and display expectations, not ticket issuance, eligibility, or expiration semantics.
The source explicitly discusses primary-mint reward accounting and does not alter secondary-sale royalties, marketplace controls, or the rule that secondary sales create no referral tickets.
